hashCount.description:
Number of hash functions used in MinHash. More hash functions leads to more accurate inclusion tests at the cost
of additional time and space. This may be extremely expensive if too large.

minCount.description:
The number of minimum hashes to store per hash function; thus, the total number of hashes stored is (hashCount *
minCount). Larger minCount leads to more accurate inclusion tests at the cost of additional time and space. This
may be extremely expensive if too large.
